name: Advanced Excel
certifications: Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) as a next step

beginner.summary: For office staff and analysts who use Excel occasionally. Covers workbook basics, formulas and references, essential functions, tables, sorting and filtering, charts, conditional formatting, data validation, lookups and a first pivot table, ending with a monthly report built from raw data.
prerequisites: Can use Windows or macOS and a mouse and keyboard
outcomes: Build clean workbooks with correct formulas and references
Use the essential text, date, logical and lookup functions
Summarise data with tables, charts and pivot tables
Protect, print and share workbooks safely

days.topic: Excel Setup, Workbook Basics and Navigation
subtopics: The ribbon, Quick Access Toolbar and status bar
days.lab_task: Create a workbook with three sheets for an expense log, enter 30 rows, freeze the header row, use ten keyboard shortcuts and save it to OneDrive with version history.
days.deliverable: Workbook and a list of the shortcuts used
checks: Previous version opens from version history

subtopics: Arithmetic operators and order of operations
days.lab_task: Build a price list that calculates tax and discount with one rate cell using absolute references, copies formulas down and across, and uses a named range for the tax rate.
checks: Mixed references keep the right row and column
objectives: Use relative, absolute and mixed references

days.topic: Essential Functions: SUM, AVERAGE, COUNT, MIN and MAX
days.lab_task: Summarise a sales sheet with totals, averages, minimum and maximum per month, count blank cells, round results and fix three planted errors.
checks: Compare totals with the status bar
Formula shows blank or zero instead

days.topic: Logical Functions: IF, AND, OR and IFS
subtopics: Logical tests on text and dates
days.lab_task: Calculate bonus eligibility, a performance grade with IFS and a commission rate with AND and OR rules for 50 employees, and handle missing data with IFERROR.
checks: Grades and bonuses match the rules
Replace a nested IF with IFS

days.lab_task: Clean a customer list by splitting names, fixing case and spaces, building email IDs, and calculate age, tenure and working days to each renewal date.
checks: Matches NETWORKDAYS by hand for two rows

days.topic: Formatting, Number Formats and Conditional Formatting
subtopics: Number, currency, percentage and date formats
Data bars, colour scales and icon sets
days.lab_task: Format a sales report with currency and percentage formats, a custom format for thousands, highlight overdue invoices with a formula rule and add data bars for sales.
checks: Change an invoice date to the past
Each rule has a clear range

subtopics: Sorting by one and many columns
days.lab_task: Convert sales data to a table, add a total row and calculated columns with structured references, sort by region then amount and filter with slicers.
checks: Add a row to the table
Sort by a custom month order

subtopics: Column, bar, line and pie charts
Combo charts with a secondary axis
days.lab_task: Build a column chart of monthly sales, a combo chart of sales and margin percent, and sparklines per product, and fix a misleading chart with a cut axis.
checks: Add a new month to the table
Show margin percent on a secondary axis
Axis starts at zero and the note explains why

days.lab_task: Bring product names and prices into an order sheet with VLOOKUP and XLOOKUP, assign discount bands with approximate match and show "Not found" for missing codes.
checks: Look up a missing product code
Look up a value to the left of the key

days.topic: Conditional Aggregation: SUMIFS, COUNTIFS and AVERAGEIFS
days.lab_task: Build a summary table of sales by region and month with SUMIFS, count large orders with COUNTIFS and average order value for products matching a wildcard.
checks: Compare the SUMIFS table with a filtered total
Change the month in the criteria cell
Use a wildcard for products starting with "Pro"

subtopics: Validation rules for numbers, dates and text
days.lab_task: Build a data entry form sheet with drop-downs from a table, a dependent city list, date limits, a duplicate check and clear error messages.
checks: Enter a date outside the allowed range
City list shows only that state's cities

subtopics: Summarising by sum, count and average
days.lab_task: Build pivot tables of sales by region and product, group dates by month and quarter, show order counts and averages, and add a pivot chart.
checks: Compare the pivot total with the data total

days.lab_task: Clean a messy export with duplicates, combined columns, numbers stored as text, extra spaces and blank rows so it is ready for a pivot table.
days.deliverable: Cleaned dataset and a cleaning log
checks: Sum a numbers-as-text column after fixing
Use Flash Fill to split names
objectives: Use Flash Fill and text to columns

days.topic: Printing, Page Layout and PDF Export
days.lab_task: Set up a 200-row report to print on A4 with repeating headers, page numbers, a company footer and set page breaks per region, then export it to PDF.
checks: Each region starts on a new page
Page numbers and company name on every page

days.lab_task: Protect a budget template so users can enter only input cells, share it for co-authoring, collect comments from two colleagues and apply a sensitivity label.
checks: Try to edit a formula cell
Edit at the same time as a colleague

days.lab_task: Build a KPI table with month-on-month growth, margin, markup, running totals and share of total for six products, and check two results by hand.
checks: Check margin and markup for one product

days.topic: Working with Multiple Sheets and Workbooks
days.lab_task: Combine 12 monthly sheets into a yearly summary with 3D references, link a summary workbook to a regional workbook and add a navigation sheet with hyperlinks.
checks: Change a value on one month's sheet
Move the linked file and open the summary

subtopics: Get Data from files and folders
Why Power Query beats copy and paste
days.lab_task: Combine 12 monthly CSV files from a folder with Power Query, clean them, load the result to a table and refresh after adding a new month.
checks: Compare totals with the source files
objectives: Import and combine data with Power Query
Refresh instead of copy and paste

days.topic: Copilot and AI Features in Excel
subtopics: Data that should not go to AI
days.lab_task: Use Copilot to create three formulas, a chart and a pivot summary on the sales table, check every result yourself and note any wrong answer.
checks: Correct or corrected with the reason
List data that should not be used with AI

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Monthly Sales Report Workbook
days.lab_task: Build a monthly sales report from raw exports: import with Power Query, clean, add lookups and KPIs, build pivots and charts, validate inputs, protect formulas and present the results.
checks: Report updates with no manual changes
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one report

intermediate.summary: For regular Excel users who want advanced skills. Covers INDEX/MATCH and XLOOKUP patterns, dynamic arrays, LET and LAMBDA, advanced pivot tables, Power Query transformations, Power Pivot and DAX, dashboards, what-if analysis, Solver, statistics, financial functions and recorded macros.
prerequisites: Uses formulas, IF, VLOOKUP or XLOOKUP and SUMIFS
Builds simple pivot tables and charts
Comfortable with tables and data validation
outcomes: Solve complex problems with modern Excel functions
Build data models with Power Query and Power Pivot
Use what-if analysis, Solver and simple macros

days.topic: Advanced Lookups: INDEX, MATCH and XLOOKUP Patterns
days.lab_task: Build a pricing tool with two-way INDEX/MATCH, a multi-criteria XLOOKUP for region and product, tier pricing with approximate match and return several columns at once.
checks: Look up a price by region and product
Return three columns with one XLOOKUP

days.topic: Dynamic Arrays: FILTER, SORT, UNIQUE and SEQUENCE
days.lab_task: Build a live report that lists unique customers, filters orders by a chosen region and date range, sorts by amount and numbers the rows, all with dynamic arrays.
checks: Reference the spill with # in a chart

subtopics: Helper functions: MAP, REDUCE, BYROW, BYCOL
days.lab_task: Rewrite three long formulas with LET, create named LAMBDA functions for tax and working-day calculations and apply BYROW to a table.
days.deliverable: Workbook with named functions and tests
checks: Use the named tax function on ten rows

subtopics: Show values as: percent of total, running total, rank
Multiple pivot tables from one cache
days.lab_task: Build pivot tables with percent of total, running totals and ranks, a calculated margin field, timelines and slicers connected to three pivots, and create one sheet per region.
Unpivot a wide budget sheet, merge actuals from a database export, group by department and month, and handle error rows in a separate query.
checks: One row per department and month
Bad rows listed in the error query

days.topic: Power Pivot and the Data Model
subtopics: Loading tables to the data model
Pivot tables from the data model
days.lab_task: Load sales, products, customers and dates into the data model, create relationships and hierarchies, and build a pivot from 2 million rows.
checks: Build a pivot from related tables
Fields from all tables work together
Loads beyond the sheet row limit

days.lab_task: Write DAX measures for revenue, margin percent, year-to-date and year-over-year growth, and use CUBEVALUE to build a custom formatted report.
checks: Compare margin percent with a manual calculation

subtopics: Charts from pivots and dynamic ranges
days.lab_task: Build a one-page sales dashboard with KPI cards, trend and regional charts, slicers, a drop-down for the metric and a refresh button, and test it with a colleague.
checks: Choose a different metric from the drop-down
Main questions answered in under a minute

days.lab_task: Build a waterfall of profit changes, a Pareto of defects, a Gantt chart for a project plan and a bullet chart against target with a dynamic title.
checks: Starting and ending profit match the data

days.topic: What-If Analysis: Goal Seek, Scenarios and Data Tables
days.lab_task: Use Goal Seek to find the break-even price, build best, base and worst scenarios for a product launch and a two-variable data table of profit by price and volume.
checks: Profit equals zero at the found price

days.lab_task: Use Solver to find the product mix that maximises profit within machine hours and materials, and a staff rota that meets demand at lowest cost.
checks: Constraints are met and profit is maximal

subtopics: Regression with LINEST and the Analysis ToolPak
days.lab_task: Describe a sales dataset, test the correlation between ad spend and sales, fit a regression and forecast the next six months with FORECAST.ETS.
checks: Mean, median and standard deviation reported
Coefficients and R-squared reported and explained

days.lab_task: Build a loan amortisation schedule, compare two investment options with NPV and IRR on irregular dates and calculate straight-line and declining depreciation.
checks: Compare XNPV and NPV for irregular dates

days.topic: Recording Macros and Automating Simple Tasks
days.lab_task: Record a macro that formats a weekly export, run it from a button on new files, edit it to remove hard-coded ranges and store it in the personal macro workbook.
days.deliverable: Macro workbook and before and after files
checks: Run the macro on a new export with more rows
Open the file with macros disabled
Run from the personal macro workbook

days.topic: Advanced Data Validation and Form Design
subtopics: Form controls and ActiveX in brief
days.lab_task: Build a data collection template with custom validation formulas, a dynamic drop-down that filters by category, form controls and protection, then collect and check five submissions.
checks: Product drop-down shows only that category
Invalid data found or none present

days.lab_task: Audit a provided budget model with ten planted errors using trace arrows, Evaluate Formula, the watch window and Inquire, fix them and document the model.
days.deliverable: Error log, fixed model and documentation
checks: Compare old and new versions with Inquire

subtopics: Limits of Excel for the web
days.lab_task: Co-author a planning workbook in Teams with two colleagues using sheet views and @mentions, restore an overwritten section from version history and set link permissions.
days.deliverable: Shared workbook and version history evidence
checks: Restore an earlier version of the sheet
Open the link as an external user

days.topic: Excel with Power BI and Other Tools
subtopics: Analyse in Excel from Power BI
When to move from Excel to Power BI
days.lab_task: Connect Excel to a SQL database with Power Query, analyse a Power BI semantic model in a pivot table and decide which of three reports should move to Power BI.
days.deliverable: Connected workbooks and a decision note
checks: Build a pivot on the Power BI model
Values match the Power BI report
objectives: Connect Excel to other data tools
Use Power BI data in Excel
Decide when to move to Power BI

days.topic: Copilot and Python in Excel for Analysis
subtopics: Copilot for formulas and conditional formatting
days.lab_task: Use Copilot to suggest an analysis of the sales table, then write Python in Excel cells to clean the data and produce a seaborn chart, checking both against formulas.
days.deliverable: Workbook with Copilot and Python results
checks: Compare the Python totals with SUMIFS

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Interactive Business Dashboard and Model
subtopics: Power Query and the data model
days.lab_task: Build a refreshable workbook that combines three sources in a data model, uses DAX and dynamic arrays, has an interactive dashboard and a scenario sheet, and is audited and documented, then present it.
days.deliverable: Workbook, audit notes and a 15-minute presentation
checks: Compare key totals with the sources
Results summarised in the scenario report
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one solution

advanced.summary: For power users, analysts and finance professionals who automate Excel. Covers VBA programming, user forms, automation across files, Office Scripts and Power Automate, financial modelling standards, forecasting and simulation, advanced LAMBDA, Python in Excel, large data, integration with databases and APIs, and spreadsheet risk management.
prerequisites: Uses dynamic arrays, pivot tables, Power Query and Power Pivot
Builds models used by other people
outcomes: Write maintainable VBA and Office Scripts automations
Build robust financial and forecasting models
Connect Excel to databases, APIs and Power Automate
Manage spreadsheet risk and build Excel tools for teams

days.topic: VBA Programming: Procedures, Data Types and the Object Model
subtopics: The Excel object model: Workbook, Worksheet, Range
Debugging with breakpoints and Immediate window
days.lab_task: Write a VBA procedure that reads every row of an order sheet, calculates totals, writes results to a summary sheet and reports the count in a message box, using Option Explicit.
checks: Misspell a variable with Option Explicit
Variables visible in the Locals window

days.topic: VBA Control Flow, Loops and Error Handling
subtopics: For, For Each and Do loops
days.lab_task: Rewrite a slow cell-by-cell macro to use arrays and turn off screen updating, add error handling that logs bad rows, and compare run times on 100,000 rows.
checks: Array version at least ten times faster
Settings are restored in the error handler

subtopics: Looping through files in a folder
days.lab_task: Build a macro that opens every regional workbook in a folder, consolidates them into one report, saves a PDF per region and logs which files were processed.
checks: Consolidated totals match the sum of the files
One per region with the right data

subtopics: Text boxes, combo boxes and list boxes
days.lab_task: Build a UserForm for entering and editing customer records with validation, a search box and save to a table, and a ribbon button that opens it.
checks: Save a record with a missing required field

subtopics: Version control for VBA with exported modules
days.lab_task: Refactor the consolidation macro into class modules and a dictionary-based lookup, export modules to Git and review the code against a checklist.
days.deliverable: Refactored code, Git history and review notes
checks: Look up 10,000 keys with a dictionary

days.topic: Automating Outlook, Word and PowerPoint from Excel
subtopics: Sending emails from Excel through Outlook
When to use Power Automate instead
days.lab_task: Send each regional manager an email with their PDF report attached, create a Word summary from a template and update charts in a PowerPoint deck from Excel.
checks: Run the email macro in test mode
Drafts created with the right attachments

days.topic: Office Scripts and Power Automate for Excel
subtopics: Office Scripts in Excel for the web
Triggering on new files or emails
Writing results to SharePoint and Teams
days.lab_task: Write an Office Script that formats and summarises a report, and a Power Automate flow that runs it whenever a file lands in SharePoint and posts the summary to Teams.
checks: Drop a file in the SharePoint folder
Flow handles the error and notifies

days.lab_task: Restructure a messy provided model into separate input, calculation and output sheets with a timeline, flags, checks and documentation, keeping the results identical.
checks: One formula per row across periods

days.lab_task: Build a five-year three-statement model with drivers, working capital and a debt schedule that balances in every period.
checks: Check the balance sheet every year
Cash flow closing equals balance sheet cash

days.topic: Valuation Models: DCF and Scenario Analysis
days.lab_task: Build a DCF valuation from the three-statement model with WACC, two terminal value methods, a sensitivity table and scenario switches, and present a valuation range.
checks: Both calculated with the difference explained

days.lab_task: Forecast monthly demand with moving averages, ETS and regression, compare them on a holdout period with MAPE and present the best forecast with a range.
checks: All three compared on the holdout

days.topic: Monte Carlo Simulation and Risk Analysis
subtopics: Random variables with RAND and distributions
days.lab_task: Simulate 10,000 outcomes of a project's profit with uncertain price, volume and cost, report the distribution and probability of loss and rank drivers with a tornado chart.

subtopics: Array manipulation: TAKE, DROP, CHOOSECOLS, VSTACK, HSTACK
Text parsing with TEXTSPLIT and REGEX functions
Sharing libraries with the Advanced Formula Environment
days.lab_task: Build a library of five named LAMBDA functions for parsing, cleaning and reporting, test them on edge cases and share the library through the Advanced Formula Environment.
checks: Parse a messy address column with TEXTSPLIT
Import the library into a new workbook

days.topic: Python in Excel for Advanced Analysis
subtopics: Python cells and the xl() function
Machine learning in brief with scikit-learn
When to use Python or formulas
days.lab_task: Use Python in Excel to segment customers by purchase behaviour, fit a regression for spend and chart the segments, and compare with an Excel-only approach.
checks: Compare group totals with a pivot table

days.topic: Working with Large Data and Performance
days.lab_task: Speed up a slow 80 MB workbook by replacing volatile functions, moving data to the data model and switching formats, and show the calculation time and size drop.

days.topic: Connecting Excel to Databases and APIs
subtopics: Parameterised SQL queries from Power Query
Calling REST APIs with Power Query
Writing data back with VBA or Power Automate
days.lab_task: Pull data from SQL with a parameterised query and from a paged REST API in Power Query, refresh both from one button and write approved changes back through Power Automate.
checks: Change the query parameter and refresh
Row count matches the API total
Flow writes it to the database

subtopics: Controls: checks, reviews, locking and versioning
days.lab_task: Risk-rate five provided business spreadsheets, add controls to the riskiest one, run an independent review with Inquire and write a recommendation on which should move to a system.
days.deliverable: Risk ratings, control set-up, review report and recommendation

days.topic: Building Excel Tools and Add-ins for Teams
days.lab_task: Package the team's macros as an XLAM add-in with a custom ribbon, distribute it through SharePoint, release an update and write a one-page user guide.
days.deliverable: Add-in, update release and user guide
checks: Users get the update from SharePoint
A new user completes the main task

days.lab_task: Fix four injected problems (a corrupt file, broken links, a failing macro after a sheet rename and wrong results from manual calculation), and write runbooks.
days.deliverable: Incident notes, fixed files and runbooks
checks: Fix the macro after the rename
Write a runbook for broken links

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Automated Financial Planning Model
days.lab_task: Build a planning model that refreshes actuals from a database, forecasts demand, links three statements with scenarios and simulation, distributes regional reports automatically and passes an independent review, then present it.
days.deliverable: Model, automation, review report and a 20-minute presentation
checks: Model updates and balances in every period
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one model
